svg.title: Cathedral & Town Hall / the square and parvis
svg.desc: District 01 concept: raised painterly view north across the market square to the parvis steps, the cathedral west front and the Town Hall with its clock tower; service-lane vignette and height ladder inset.
svg.text: GD / 01 CATHEDRAL & TOWN HALL / THE SQUARE AND PARVIS
Raised view north along the ceremonial axis, autumn morning, low sun upper left / cathedral on the fountain axis, Town Hall and clock to the west.
Inset A / service lane behind the east civic row: unlit, worn, damp.
Inset B / height ladder (m): one upward reward, the cathedral alone above 40 m.

CONCEPT / NOVEMBER 2026 • PROPOSED, NOT AN ENGINE CAPTURE • cathedral west front 38 m, ten 17 cm parvis risers to +1.7 m podium, fountain basin r 8 m, round civic arches, pointed only on the cathedral
